join.noToken.title: Open the whole link
join.noToken.body: This page needs the whole invitation link, including the part after the # sign, which stays in this tab only. Open the link you were sent again. If you no longer have it, ask whoever invited you to send it again.
join.opening.title: Opening your invitation
join.opening.body: Checking the invitation on this device.
join.closed.title: This invitation cannot be used
join.closed.notFound: There is no invitation at this link. Check that you have the whole link, or ask whoever invited you for a new one.
join.closed.withdrawn: The company withdrew this invitation, so there is no offer here any more. If you were expecting to join, ask whoever sent it to you.
join.closed.expired: This invitation has expired. Nothing has been sent and nothing has changed. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.
join.closed.expiredAt: This invitation expired at {when}. Nothing has been sent and nothing has changed. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.
join.closed.used: This invitation has already been accepted, so it cannot be accepted again. If that was not you, tell whoever invited you now.
join.closed.notAccepted: The service did not take what was sent as accepting this invitation. Open the whole link again on the device you are joining from.
join.closed.notOpened: This invitation could not be opened on this device. Nothing was sent. Ask whoever invited you for a new link.
join.closed.superAdmin: A super admin is added by the company's own super admins, with their own proposal, so this invitation cannot be accepted here. Nothing was sent. Ask whoever invited you to take this to the company's super admins.
join.closed.seatByAddressOnly: This invitation offers a seat in a way this page no longer takes: signers are invited at their private address. Nothing was sent. Ask whoever invited you to invite you again.
join.closed.unreachable: The service could not be reached, so the invitation could not be opened. Nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.
join.offer.title: {company} invited you
join.kind.employee: You are invited to be paid as an employee.
join.kind.vendor: You are invited to be paid as a vendor.
join.kind.signer: You are invited to sign for the company.
join.kind.reissue: A signer of the company has sent again the invitation your seat was proposed under, because the signer who invited you has left.
join.field.name: Name
join.field.title: Job title
join.way.seat: Your wallet opens to confirm this before anything is sent. It proves on the network that it holds the private address you were invited at, and takes your seat. Your keys stay in the wallet.
join.way.code: Your wallet opens to confirm this before anything is sent. It makes your pay details and a code for this company, with a private address of its own, and then shows a fingerprint in its own window while it joins. Read it out to whoever invited you, so they can check it is you.
join.way.codeAt: You were invited at the private address above. Your wallet must hold it, and opens to confirm this before anything is sent. It then shows a fingerprint in its own window while it joins. Read it out to whoever invited you, so they can check it is you.
join.way.claim: You were invited at the public address above. Your wallet must hold it, and opens to confirm this before anything is sent. It signs a claim to the address. There is no fingerprint to read out. Your pay will be sent to that public address, and anyone can look up each payment and its amount.
join.way.reissue: Your wallet opens to confirm this before anything is sent. It keeps this invitation for the seat it already holds on this company, with the signer who sent it as who invited you, only if every term is the one your seat was proposed under. Nothing is sent.
join.signIn.why: Sign in so your wallet can act for you. Signing in accepts nothing: you come back to this invitation on this page and are asked to accept it there.
join.working.step: Waiting for your wallet, step {step} of {steps}
join.stopped.title: This stopped before it finished
join.stopped.used: This invitation has already been accepted. If that was not you, tell whoever invited you now.
join.stopped.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.
join.stopped.alreadySeated: This wallet already holds a seat in this company, so it cannot take another. Use a different wallet, or ask whoever invited you.
join.stopped.usedByThisWallet: This wallet already joined with this invitation. Its fingerprint is shown again in the wallet window: read it out to whoever invited you.
join.stopped.notHeld: This wallet does not hold the address you were invited at. Open the wallet that does, sign in with it, and open the link again.
join.stopped.noSavedKeys: Your account's saved keys could not be opened here. Sign out, sign in again, and open the link again.
join.stopped.noSlots: Your wallet could not read the company's seats just now. Nothing was sent. Press the button again in a minute.
join.stopped.notByAddress: This invitation is not made at an address of the kind this wallet can take. Ask whoever invited you to invite you again.
join.stopped.noOffer: The invitation could not be read again. Open the whole link again, or ask whoever invited you for a new one.
join.stopped.anotherCompany: This invitation is not from the company the link named. Nothing was done. Ask whoever invited you for a new link.
join.stopped.byPublicAddress: This invitation was made at a public address, which is claimed from the wallet holding that address. Open the link again and use that wallet.
join.stopped.notTaken: The company did not take your details. Press the button again. If it stops again, tell whoever invited you and read out the fingerprint your wallet showed in its window.
join.stopped.notTakenClaim: The company did not take your claim. Press the button again. If it stops again, tell whoever invited you.
join.stopped.notSent: The proof of your seat did not reach the network. Press the button again to send it.
join.stopped.sent: Your wallet handed over the proof of your seat before this stopped, and it may already have been sent. Wait a few minutes and open the link again before you press the button again.
join.stopped.notAsked: The company did not take your request to be admitted. Press the button again to ask again.
join.stopped.takenByAnother: This invitation's seat has already been taken, by keys this wallet does not make. Ask whoever invited you to invite you again.
join.stopped.noFreeSeat: This wallet has no seat of its own left to take on this company. Ask whoever invited you to invite you again.
join.stopped.other: Your wallet said why in its window. Press the button again to go on, and if it stops again, ask whoever invited you.
join.done.title: Your wallet has answered the invitation from {company}
join.done.seat: Your wallet sent the proof of your seat. You are not a signer yet: the company admits you when one of its signers presses Finish adding. Until then you are waiting; if it takes long, ask the signer who invited you. After you are admitted, give your vault keys from the company's page.
join.done.code: Your wallet showed a fingerprint in its own window while it joined. Read it out to whoever invited you: they check it before they admit you, and the company cannot pay you until they have. The fingerprint is shown once. If you missed it, tell whoever invited you; they invite you again.
join.done.claim: Your wallet signed a claim to the public address you were invited at, and it is with the company. A signer checks the claim and admits you. There is no fingerprint to read out. The company cannot pay you until you are admitted.
join.done.reissue: Your wallet keeps this invitation for your seat, with the signer who sent it as who invited you. Open the company and press Give your keys under Signers to finish joining.
join.left.title: You left this invitation
join.left.body: Nothing was sent. The invitation stays open until it expires or the company withdraws it. Open the link again to come back to it.
